identical_deltas_are_coincidence_not_a_b.observation: both poles returned delta=+0.46875 and LCB95=+0.3125, identical to 4 decimals, which is exactly what a duplicated run would look like
identical_deltas_are_coincidence_not_a_b.checked: the two paired-difference vectors were compared element by element and are DIFFERENT (dA != dB). They simply both sum to 15 of 32.
identical_deltas_are_coincidence_not_a_b.why_the_LCB_matches_too: a paired bootstrap of a 0/1 difference vector depends only on the COUNT of ones, and the statistic is discrete in steps of 1/32, so two vectors with 15 ones each snap to the same lattice point for the 2.5th percentile
identical_deltas_are_coincidence_not_a_b.cross_check: only 23 of 64 A-vs-B cells share identical (blue,red) scores, most of them 0-0 draws; the poles are genuinely distinct runs

criterion_3_observability_FAIL.metric: mean(t_intent - t_commit) over the 32 BREACH episodes on the A pole
criterion_3_observability_FAIL.frozen_convention: censored values coded as MAX_STEPS+1 = 241, then mean > 0. This is the SAME construction the development criterion used (paired_eval in the frozen searcher sets precommitment_uncertain = mean_gap > 0.0), so development and confirmation are directly comparable.
criterion_3_observability_FAIL.did_not_replicate: the development result reversed sign on fresh untouched seeds
criterion_3_observability_FAIL.what_drives_the_failure: the 5 episodes where BREACH never got both agents onto RED's half. t_commit is censored to 241 while t_intent was observed early, producing gaps near -230 that dominate the mean. The censored-coded median is +2.5 and 65.6% of episodes are positive, yet the mean is -17.4.
criterion_3_observability_FAIL.explicitly_not_done: the statistic was NOT switched to median, complete-case mean, or any other estimator after seeing the data. Under the frozen convention this criterion FAILS, and that is the recorded outcome.

degeneracy_reported_not_gating.status: degeneracy was part of the search objective J, not a listed Gate B criterion, so it does not change the verdict. It is reported because it qualifies what the wins mean: most episodes are scoreless, and the reversal shows up as 'the favoured style converts ~47% of episodes while the disfavoured style converts 0%'.
